title: Garry Oaks Winery
specs: Sustainability practices including organic methods and composting
Preservation of century-old orchard and Garry Oak trees
includes: Wine selections including bubbly, rosé, white and red
Private tour with winemaker or owner
Lodging stays in loft or treehouse (for higher tiers)
blurb: Garry Oaks Estate Winery grows grapes sustainably on Salt Spring Island and produces award-winning wines including sparkling and dessert wines. The winery preserves a century-old orchard and Garry Oak trees on its estate. They offer wine club memberships that include wine selections, private tours, tastings, picnics, and lodging stays.
